· 成本：单个对象最坏多占 12.5%；小于 4KB 的对象一律按 4KB 计；: · Cost: each object can take up to 12.5% more space; objects under 4KB are all counted as 4KB;
· 只影响开启之后新写入的内容，已有文件在下次修改时才会被填充；: · Only affects content written after this is enabled; existing files are padded the next time they are modified;
· 仓库内去重不受影响（填充在密文内部，同样的内容仍得到同样的密文）。: · Deduplication inside the vault is unaffected (padding happens inside the ciphertext, so identical content still produces identical ciphertext).
把上传对齐到时间窗口并加随机抖动，服务器只能判断编辑发生在哪个窗口里，而不是精确: Aligns uploads to time windows with random jitter, so the server can tell which window an edit landed in, but not the exact second. Request rhythm is itself a keystroke record: your schedule, timezone, weekdays and holidays, even whether you are awake, can be inferred from it.
·「立即同步」命令不受影响，用户显式要求的动作不会被推迟。: · The "Sync Now" command is unaffected — an action the user explicitly asked for is never delayed.
